mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the federal funds rate above 4.5% signals a tightening monetary cycle that increases discount rates on future equity cash flows, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in less than 40% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 4.5%, or the average return in triggered periods is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the unemployment rate below 4.0% signals tight labor market conditions that increase wage pressures and inflation expectations, prompting the Fed to maintain restrictive policy and suppress equity valuations, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in less than 40% of instances when UNRATE < 4.0%, or the average return in triggered periods is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in housing starts above 1.35 million units signals strong consumer confidence and rising demand for durable goods and services, which drives corporate revenue growth and supports positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in less than 40% of instances when HOUST > 1350.0, or the average return in triggered periods is not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in industrial production below 102.0 indicates weakening manufacturing activity and broadening economic slowdown, which reduces corporate earnings expectations and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in less than 40% of instances when INDPRO < 102.0, or the average return in triggered periods is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in both real personal consumption expenditures (GDPC1) and residential fixed investment (RSAFS) signals broad-based demand strength that supports corporate revenue growth and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in less than 50% of instances when both GDPC1 and RSAFS are rising, or the joint signal has a Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in the CPIAUCSL above 315.0 combined with a stable FEDFUNDS rate signals persistent inflationary pressure that triggers forward-looking equity risk premiums, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in less than 40% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 315.0 and FEDFUNDS is stable, or the interaction signal has a Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in non-farm payrolls and a decline in the unemployment rate signals strong labor market momentum that boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5d returns in less than 50% of instances when PAYEMS rises and UNRATE falls, or the joint signal has a Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real personal consumption expenditures (GDPC1) combined with rising housing starts (HOUST) indicates strong consumer demand and confidence, which drives corporate revenue growth and supports positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in less than 50% of instances when both GDPC1 and HOUST are rising, or the joint signal has a Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
